mintAuthority.summary: USDm minting on Celo routes through the authorized Mento Broker, while the same 4-of-6 Mento Safe can authorize minters and immediately replace token logic on both Celo and Monad. The NEAR representation has one FullAccess key that can replace its bridge-token contract. These self-controlled paths make issuance economically unbounded.

upgradeability.controlRef: Mento USDm token owner Safe (Celo + Monad)

controls.label: Mento Broker — authorized Celo USDm minter
controls.evidence: At Celo block 74314266, USDm isMinter(0x777a8255ca72412f0d706dc03c9d1987306b4cad) returned true. The verified Mento Broker is therefore the active contract minter; its issuance path is governed by Mento exchange and reserve logic but has no immutable token-level numeric supply ceiling.

controls.label: Mento USDm token owner Safe (Celo + Monad)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 74314266, USDm owner(), proxy _getOwner(), and the EIP-1967 admin slot all returned this Safe; _getImplementation() returned 0x815795c30d0758a297b08cd4e0643620c974c318 and isMinter(Broker) was true. On-chain Safe reads and the Safe Transaction Service returned the same six owners, threshold 4, no modules, and zero guard. At Monad block 94280759, the USDm owner and ProxyAdmin owner were the same address and its Monad Safe copy also returned the same six owners and threshold 4. The Safe can authorize minters and replace mint logic immediately, so it can raise or remove issuance bounds.

controls.label: NEAR cUSD bridge-token FullAccess key
controls.evidence: At finalized NEAR height 210490105, cusd.token.a11bd.near had deployed code hash 2K5PmiMQgfCZWirws2FS5mUNVc1UfHQdQD5ZSRUQB2GR and exactly one FullAccess key, ed25519:BnTCngEURgq83qHXB94ZmLgb6ea93o25TDKQNCip7mtb. The same key is also present on a11bd.near, while a separate parent key does not automatically control the child. NEAR's primary documentation confirms a FullAccess key can call any method, add keys, and redeploy contract code, so this single key can replace bridge-token mint logic even though the current contract exposes no owner view.

review.evidence: At Celo block 74314266, the verified USDm proxy's owner(), _getOwner(), and EIP-1967 admin slot all resolved to the 4-of-6 Mento Safe; _getImplementation() and the implementation slot both resolved to 0x815795c30d0758a297b08cd4e0643620c974c318, and the Mento Broker remained an authorized minter. The same Safe address owned the Monad token and Monad ProxyAdmin at block 94280759, with the same six owners and 4-of-6 threshold; the prior seventh Monad signer was no longer present. Neither path has an independent timelock, so the Safe can authorize or replace mint logic and overall cap semantics are unbounded. At finalized NEAR height 210490105, the cUSD bridge-token account had exactly one FullAccess key; contrary to the previous profile, the parent account does not control a subaccount merely through account hierarchy, but the shared key directly controls this child and can redeploy its code. Mento publishes live on-chain reserve state and a continuously updating dashboard, supporting continuous reconciliation; no prudential supervisor was identified.
